He states that every chapter mentions a money-making secret that produced fortunes for over 500 exceedingly wealthy people he analyzed over a long period of years. The secret was brought to his attention by Andrew Carnegie more than a quarter-century ago, when Carnegie 'carelessly tossed it' into Hill's mind when Hill was but a boy, then sat back with a merry twinkle to see if Hill had brains enough to grasp its full significance. Carnegie's experience with Charles M.
